clips.title: The story
paras: South of Orgrimmar's main gate, Jaggedswine Farm raises swine for the capital. Its shed, pen, and watering hole serve the Horde's nearby stronghold.

Jaggedswine Farm shows the harsh work of feeding an urban stronghold like Orgrimmar. Durotar's red soil supports little farming, so hardy livestock helps feed the city's warriors and laborers. A timber storehouse, a broad wooden pen, and a natural watering hole anchor the farm. Swine are herded, bred, and butchered here to keep the Horde's granaries supplied.

Swineherds and patrolling Orgrimmar Grunts visit the farm, though the dry heat can leave it looking half-tended. Wild and mature swine roam inside and beyond the enclosures, sometimes testing nearby guards. The farm stands at the edge of the valley approach to the capital, an unassuming but necessary part of Durotar's daily supply work.
